notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/15/2025
notes.content: -Fixed error where hiragana wouldn't "evolve" until dying after reaching the appropriate milestones.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 6/29/2025
notes.content:
-Fixed minor glitch in credits. 
-Redesigned the shop a bit.

notes.title: 6/5/2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Potions now heal for a flat 100 HP
-CP Bonuses upgraded to restore a flat 100 CP
-New item added: Large Potion - Heals for a flat 300 HP
-CP Potions removed from shop
-Potions removed from possible treasure chest drops and replaced with Large Potions (Treasure chests now drop a CP Bonus or a Large Potion)

notes.title: 5/28/2025 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed a problem with k-column sometimes not dropping essence when evolved.
-hiragana now have a 1/3 chance to drop a second essence after evolving.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 5/22/2025
notes.content:
-changed default audio to be 40%
-reworded potion and cp bonus explanations
-changed load screen to require input after loading
-changed the way hp regen and cp regen appear in equip menu
-reworded some tutorials regarding the names of buttons
-fixed an instance of speech bubble not showing protagonist when practicing dakuten

notes.title: 5/16 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Fixed some hiradex errors
-Added Shop to end of Volcano area

notes.title: Emergency End Game Patch
notes.content:
-Fixed problem with enemies dying without being attacked in a certain boss. 
-Fixed problem with credits acting funny when played a second time.

notes.title: Post-release minor update.
notes.content:
-Fixed some minor typos.
-Slightly changed the layout of first boss floor.
